coveffectsplot-style forest plot style (plot_forest)

Source: R/style_presets.R
style_forest_coveffectsplot.Rd

An alternative ggstylekit::style_spec() for plot_forest() / plot_build_forest() that reproduces the default look of the forest_plot() function of the coveffectsplot package: blue points (shape 16, size 4) on thick blue interval lines, blue reference points, a thick dashed black reference line, a grey equivalence band at alpha 80/255, grey major gridlines on both axes, grey-filled covariate strips placed between the level labels and the panels, separated panels, and a centered estimate column.

Usage

style_forest_coveffectsplot(...)

Arguments

...

Fields passed to ggstylekit::style_spec(), overriding the preset defaults; call the preset with no arguments to view them. Per-series maps merge entry-wise onto the defaults (e.g. colors = c(point = "darkred") leaves the other roles blue); colors entries keyed by covariate name opt into per-covariate coloring as in style_forest(). All other fields replace their default wholesale.

Value

A ggstylekit_style_spec object.

Details

Series roles are those of style_forest(). The plot keeps the plot_forest() layout, so it differs from coveffectsplot in that: text is scaled to an 11 pt base (coveffectsplot uses base_size = 22), with the covariate strips raised to the axis text size for legibility; there are no minor gridlines and no legend; the band is drawn only when ref_band is supplied (coveffectsplot shows 0.8-1.25 by default); the estimate column is est (lo, hi) axis text under an Estimate (CI) header rather than a separate bordered table; reference rows show a point without an interval; and the x-axis is labeled with the metric.

See also

Other forest plot: df_forest(), df_forest_preprocess(), is_forest_stats(), plot_build_forest(), plot_forest(), style_forest(), style_forest_pmforest(), style_forest_pmxforest(), style_forest_pumas()
